title: predict.request
description: Phase 5.1: API/reactor → predictors. Control-plane topic — unversioned by design (ROADMAP §3.7) because it is internal swarm traffic, never persisted, and never consumed across release boundaries. The requester (Phase 9 API or LivePredictorReactor) generates `request_id`; it round-trips unchanged through `predict.vote` and `predict.final`. Phase 8 §8.16.12 adds the optional payload field `kind_schema_version`: legacy payloads omit it (treated as version 1), current producers emit version 2 for the additive `qa_correlation_id` shape. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::PredictRequest`.

profile_id.description: Phase 13a CalibrationProfile id; defaults to league_id until then.

kind_schema_version.description: Optional payload schema marker. 1 = legacy payload without qa_correlation_id. 2 = current additive shape. When absent, consumers must treat the payload as version 1 for backward compatibility.

qa_correlation_id.description: Optional QA fanout correlation id copied from qa.request.v1.envelope.message_id when one QA request spawns multiple predict.request payloads.

features.description: Optional pre-computed feature snapshot supplied by the requester.
